note: Warmth (Dave 2026-10-21: cold costs health, slowly down to 1, like hunger). A vital 0 to 100 shown as the Warmth bar at the top of the inventory and Tab screens only. Each slow tick the server works out the warmth the body is heading for: 100 minus the cold stress. Stress is the degrees below comfort_c (air temperature from the weather and altitude, less wind chill when exposed, plus fire_c near a lit fire), times rain_mult in rain or snow on you, times water_mult when swimming, times gain, cut by the clothing insulation (0 to 0.85; no clothes exist yet, insulation_of is the hook). Warmth moves toward that target with a time constant in game hours (tau_cool falling, tau_warm rising: a fire warms you quicker than the cold chills you). Below cold_at you shiver (exertion rises faster, health stops regenerating); below hurt_at cold costs health hurt_per_s, more the colder, never below 1. Messages use two levels so they do not flicker. Swimming (Tyler): the stress comes from the WATER temperature instead of the air: water_c = water_base_c + water_follow x (air at sea level - water_base_c), never under 1 C; stress = water_comfort_c - water_c, times water_gain (so 10 C water cuts the target to about 20 and 25 C water barely matters); the body cools with tau_water_h instead of tau_cool_h. Day and night swing (Tyler): the air is the weather's seasonal temperature plus daily_offset: a swing of daily_swing_c by season (temperate; night low to afternoon high on a clear calm day), low at daily_low_hour, high at daily_high_hour, shrunk by cloud (x0.5 at overcast), rain or snow (x0.4) and wind (x0.7 at full), growing 5 percent per 300 m of height. Server side only.
